_note: SECOND PASS, run against the already-installed instance. bootstrap DEFERS jobs and workers from a fresh install because a worker's deployment carries a digest-sealed input manifest naming the Authority and the Work. Every first-pass member is repeated verbatim; a repeated bootstrap preserves what is there and refuses a changed selection. The `_note` member itself is NOT part of the input: strip it before running, or bootstrap refuses the unknown member, which is the behaviour this packet relies on everywhere else.
